name: Historic Area of Willemstad, Inner City and Harbour, Curaçao
description: Willemstad, the capital of Curaçao in the southern Caribbean, grew around a natural harbour where the Dutch founded a trading post in 1634. Its historic core spans four quarters, including Punda and Otrobanda on opposite sides of Sint Anna Bay, with Dutch-style townhouses in many forms. The city is also home to the oldest surviving synagogue in the Americas.
